## What it is

Inspecto is the Inspecto Platform with the Add-ons you choose, for teams that build their own Pipelines, Apps and controls.

## Apps

- **[Link Analysis](../../app/link-analysis/index.md)** (optional) — Investigate how entities link, one expand step at a time. Your Datasets: add files, see what arrived, and choose how each is read as a graph. Place entities and routes on a map, over any Dataset with coordinates. See what the data says about each Entity Type and each Entity: how many, where, how fresh. Keep watch lists of entities, with every change on the record. See fired Alerts, and open the Investigation behind a standing detection.
